images.caption: NASA's Mars Perseverance rover acquired this image using its Left Mastcam-Z camera. Mastcam-Z is a pair of cameras located high on the rover's mast. This image was acquired on April 12, 2021 (Sol 51) at the local mean solar time of 13:13:55.
